episode_title: A Blueprint for High-Cash-Flow Rentals with Dr. Ryan Chaw | Episode 028 | Rent Ready Radio

real_qa.q: How much monthly cash flow does the rent-by-the-room strategy generate per single family home in student housing?
real_qa.r: If you rent six bedrooms at $700 per bedroom, that's $4,200 a month in rental income. With a mortgage payment of approximately $2,000 a month and maintenance costs of around $300 a month, you can generate about $1,900 a month in cash flow per single family home. If you buy five properties using this strategy, you would make approximately $10,000 a month in cash flow.
real_qa.requete: rent by the room cash flow per property

real_qa.q: What is the REVIEW acronym that Dr. Ryan Chaw uses to inspect key property systems before buying a rental?
real_qa.r: The REVIEW acronym covers six critical systems: R stands for roof, the first E stands for electricals, V stands for ventilation (HVAC), I stands for infrastructure (foundation), the second E stands for excrement (sewage line), and W stands for water lines. These inspections help identify major problems that could cost thousands of dollars later.

real_qa.q: How quickly can real estate investors double their money using the appreciation and equity strategy that Dr. Ryan Chaw describes?
real_qa.r: Real estate doubles your money every three to four years. If you put 20% down and the property appreciates 7% per year on average (as in California), after three years that's a 21% gain on the property, which equals a 100% return on your down payment. You can then access this equity through a home equity line of credit or cash-out refinance to invest in additional properties.
real_qa.requete: real estate double money three four years

real_qa.q: What was the total cost of Dr. Ryan Chaw's early mistakes on his first rental property in Stockton, California?
real_qa.r: Dr. Chaw lost over $30,000 on his first house. He had to replace an entire sewage line for $9,000 after tree roots broke it, and replace an HVAC system for $15,000. He later realized that a $200 sewage line inspection during the home inspection phase would have saved him the $9,000 sewage repair.
real_qa.requete: first rental property mistakes cost Stockton

real_qa.q: What are the three R's that Dr. Ryan Chaw uses to evaluate student housing investments?
real_qa.r: The three R's are: buy nearby the right college (using the U.S. News Top Colleges Report as a guide), buy the right property (using the BIG acronym: Big size at 1,500+ square feet, Inviting neighborhood that's safe, and Geographically close to school), and bring in the right tenants (focusing on professional, doctorate-level students).
real_qa.requete: three Rs student housing investment strategy

guest.titre: Real Estate Investor and Student Housing Specialist
guest.bio_context: Ryan started his career as a pharmacist but transitioned to real estate investing full-time at age 31 after building a portfolio focused on student housing using a rent-by-the-room strategy. He became a millionaire at 28 and currently owns 14 student rental properties. He uses systems from his hospital pharmacy background, including root cause analysis and debriefs, to manage his real estate operations with a team of virtual assistants.
